diagnosis: Clone tracing makes every rustc thread a tracee, and a traced thread-group leader is reapable only after each traced thread is reaped. Teardown reaped only thread IDs whose clone events it had drained; threads killed before their events were drained stayed unreaped, so the owned-child drop blocked forever in a leader wait that only the blocked tracer could unblock.

behavior: Teardown and the tracer drop reap the owned process group with waitpid(-root, WNOHANG | __WALL), including untracked traced threads.
The owned-child drop waits at most the teardown deadline instead of blocking.
An observation error during teardown is recorded as the run's failure; teardown still completes.
A group too large to observe gets no further grace before SIGKILL, and is reported incomplete rather than as a harness error.
repair.regression: observed_process::tests::traced_threads_beyond_the_task_bound_are_reaped_without_blocking (256-thread child past the 128-task bound): incomplete, fully reaped and returned within the deadline
